value.rationale: A natural exact finite cutoff: the degree-only habitat-capacity loss proxy is guaranteed robust to ties through four patches, can choose badly at five, and cannot rescue itself even through ideal tie-breaking at six. All exceptional motifs and their precise Perron-root gaps are enumerated; this is a meaningful algorithmic benchmark for conservation-network triage despite being a deliberately restricted binary-corridor model. The claim does not assert empirical persistence probabilities or a global conservation recommendation.
